messages:
alex_pm: Heads-up — competitor 'AuroraAI' just announced a low-latency Dedicated offering, pricing looks ~20% below our Dedicated SKU. They emphasize 1) lower tail latency 2) aggressive quantization. Getting inbound from sales already. Do we reprioritize? :eyes:

sam_eng: Saw the doc. Their perf seems driven by custom kernels + model-specific quant flows. We can get similar P50/P90 for many models but it needs kernel selector changes + perf testing. Ballpark 6-8w for a safe rollout, 3-4w for a risky fasttrack.

priya_research: We ran a q8 spike on A1004 last month — ~10-15% token cost reduction, but we saw subtle degradation on long-context summarization tests. Might be ok for short chat use-cases. Need eval sets.

rafael_sales: Getting pressure from two logos in finance and one health startup — they asked if we can match Aurora's SLA/latency. If we don't offer a competitive response soon we'll lose pilot RFIs.

alex_pm: Quick options on the table: A) Fast-track low-latency bundle (4w aggressive) with limited model compatibility B) Double-down on reliability/observability + price defense (marketing + pricing comps) C) Canary pilot: build a targeted low-latency variant for top 5 enterprise deals and keep public messaging on reliability. Need a decision by EOD Fri.

sam_eng: A requires infra toggles: continuous batching tuning, kernel selector flagging per-model, and perf gating in CI. Also infra SLO risk during rollout. 4w is optimistic.

priya_research: B keeps quality but likely won't stop churn on latency-led objections. C is most pragmatic: validate perf vs quality on real workloads.

rafael_sales: Strong +1 for C. Sales can arrange pilot contracts (time-limited) if we promise a controlled canary. Gives us breathing room and leverage.

marta_design: If we do C we need a landing tile + pilot quickstart + one-pager for Legal. I can turn a pilot kit in 48h if PMs provide acceptance criteria.

devops-bot: deploy-notify: Canary infra quota requested: 3x small GPU hosts in us-west. ETA pending approvals.

alex_pm: Decision lean: go with C (canary pilot + simultaneous marketing posture emphasizing reliability + routing flexes). Owners: sam_eng -> pilot infra + perf tests, priya_research -> eval suites & quality gates, marta_design -> pilot kit & collateral, rafael_sales -> recruit pilot customers.

sam_eng: I'll scope infra changes and post a minimal rollout plan by tomorrow. Expect a perf test matrix like:

```
- models: [redwood-7b, llama-2-13b]
- tokens: [512, 2048, 8192]
- metrics: p50/p90/p99 latency, tokens/sec, quality-regression on eval set
- flags: kernel_selector=fast-path, quant_profile=q8_aggressive
```

priya_research: Will prep a focused eval set (customer-provided + internal long-context tests) and define pass/fail thresholds.

rafael_sales: I'll line up two pilots — finance + health. I'll ask legal for a pilot NDA template.

alex_pm: Timeline: Day0 decision (today) -> Day2 pilot design + infra reqs -> Day7 canary deploy -> Day21 pilot evaluation and go/no-go. If all good, decide public bundle strategy.

marta_design: Noted. I'll draft the pilot one-pager and quickstart by EOD tomorrow.

alex_pm: Thanks all. If anyone objects to C, flag now. Otherwise I'll announce to execs and Ops to approve infra quota. :thumbsup:
